title: Antifight Font
author: Typia Nesia
description:
Antifight – Modern Gothic Blackletter Font – Classic Vintage Logo Display Font
Antifight is a bold and powerful modern Gothic blackletter font that blends the spirit of medieval Old English style with a sharp contemporary edge. Designed with strong, angular strokes and dramatic letterforms, this typeface captures the essence of hardcore music, underground culture, and dark aesthetics while maintaining a clean and modern structure. It is perfect for music merchandise, band logos, game titles, esports branding, horror posters, streetwear designs, tattoo-inspired graphics, bold logo creations, and any project that demands a fearless and dominant presence.
Download Antifight now and make your project stand out with gothic dominance.
